contentList.content: Camp Buffs Ring
Allows casting all chosen camp buffs in a single spell. Use hotbar passives to toggle which buffs to apply.
Cast Camp Buffs
Apply all enabled camp buffs to all party members in a 30m radius.
Remove Camp Buffs
Remove all applied camp buffs from all party members in a 30m radius.
Camp Buff: Longstrider
Include Longstrider (+3m movement) when casting Camp Buffs.
Camp Buff: Mage Armor
Include Mage Armor (base AC 13 for unarmored) when casting Camp Buffs.
